newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's emir amends law on treasury bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's emir amends law on treasury bond issues.

text.p: Bahrain's emir on Wednesday issued a decree altering the law to allow the finance and national economy minister to issue treasury and development bonds, the official Gulf News Agency (GNA) reported.
"The minister of finance and national economy is authorised to issue treasury and development bonds with the agreement of the Bahrain Monetary Agency," GNA said.
It did not specify the bonds' maturity, but the decree said that at any one time, the value of issued bonds should not exceed 600 million dinars ($1.59 billion).
Bahrain issues 10 million dinars worth of 91-day treasury bills weekly. Issues of five million dinars of 182-day bills are also made occasionally.
